_doc: proof:lighthouse-mobile — the T-open BEFORE baseline (T.G9 / lane 32 T-PERF-C). VERDICT #19 ('the performance on every single page is god awful'). This is the ONE existing perf instrument whose verdict agrees with 'god awful' — and the one nobody ran in a biting posture. Run hard (KF_REQUIRE_LH=1, local IN_CI:false) against `tranche-s-impl @ 929ef0e`'s `dist/gh-pages`, EVERY scene misses its mobile-performance ceiling and spring's LCP blows past its bound: FAIL(6), exits non-zero. Two things muted it: (1) the KF_REQUIRE_LH=1 hard branch is never set by any ci.yml job (the hard branch appears to have never executed in automation); (2) even the observe-branch misses were only printed, never accumulated into a committed baseline a T wave could diff against. THIS file is that committed baseline — a board-reconcilable fact (T.M9), not a re-derivable transcript curiosity. The gate greens only once mobile perf is restored to the B floors on a CALIBRATED runner — the falsifiable form of VERDICT #19's mobile half.
_environment: local, IN_CI:false; chromium via KF_PLAYWRIGHT_DIR=/Users/mkbabb/Programming/glass-ui, lighthouse via KF_LIGHTHOUSE_DIR=/Users/mkbabb/Programming/speedtest; mobile screen emulation 375x667 dpr2, formFactor mobile
_note: The B-baseline floors (SCENE_CEILINGS in scripts/proof-lighthouse-mobile.mjs) are the no-regression floors: the mobile Perf score MUST be >= the floor. The T-open measured Perf is BELOW the floor for every scene (born-RED), and spring's LCP is above its bound. proof:lighthouse-mobile's `baseline-below-floor` static clause reads this file and asserts the committed T-open state is exactly this born-RED — a machine-checked fact that runs device-independently even when the browser/lighthouse binary is withheld locally. The calibrated runner (KF_REQUIRE_LH=1) is the infra dependency (T.G9 lockstep, → T.Z/T.S deploy-of-record); until it is provisioned, this committed baseline + the local hard run stand as the proof-of-red.
